verdict.rationale: Jan's API reference documents that POST /v1/chat/completions on its llama.cpp-powered, OpenAI-compatible local server "Supports streaming, tool calling, and multi-turn conversations," so native tool calling in requests is a first-party claim. Nothing in the evidence covers reasoning-parser support, such as separating reasoning or thinking content in responses, so only half the story is shown. Missing for 10: any documentation of reasoning-parser or reasoning-content support, detail on the tool-calling request/response format or supported models, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
